informal_statement: The stationary fold is the strict maximum of the equal-area perimeter gap.
reason: Equivalent in the declared constructor/section context. At EqualAreaEnvelope.lean:582-631, the source contract is `theorem equalAreaPerimeterGap_lt_fold {lam : ℝ} (env : DescendingEqualAreaEnvelope lam) {h₄ : ℝ} (hh₄ : 0 < h₄) (hh₄_one : h₄ ≤ 1) (hne : h₄ ≠ env.fold) : equalAreaPerimeterGap lam env.root h₄ < equalAreaPerimeterGap lam env.root env.fold`. Equal area and the negative-fold branch are distinct requirements. Interior differentiation requires a simple root; the closure endpoint uses one-sided continuity. The main proof derives these properties rather than assuming the all-curvature perimeter comparison.
